description.description: The description is a longer text chosen by the user to provide more context for the resource.

displayName.description: The display name is a short name chosen by the user to identify the resource.

labels.description: Labels are key-value pairs associated with the resource.

password.description:
A password chosen by the user.

The password must consist of at least of each of these categories:
* lower case letter
* upper case letter
* number
* other character

userType.description: Type of user, 'intake' allows writing to the Intake, 'dead-letter' allows reading from the dead-letter queue
